top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Gas Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(13))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The most recent gas leak test was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Crackers were served on a bare table for children to eat from.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregiver was observed to not wash the infant's hands before eating.

top_violation_types.title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A table manufactured for use with safety straps does not have safety straps on it. Children were observed at the table without being strapped in.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing Before Feeding a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers did not wash their hands before feeding children and after removing gloves.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.
